evals.prompt: Cut release 1.4.0 of our npm CLI `mycli`. Releases are made from branch release/1.x; a workflow publishes to npm when a v* tag is pushed. The CLI is also installed as a Claude Code plugin on this machine. Give the full plan with exact commands; do not run them.
evals.expected_output: reads RELEASING.md first; bounded npm poll; back-merge release/1.x into main via PR; updates the installed plugin/CLI and verifies --version; notes a running session may keep the old plugin bin on PATH; done only after back-merge and version check
assertions: asks for the user's explicit OK before merging the release PR, before pushing the tag, and before merging the back-merge PR
watches the workflow run matched to the tag's commit, not `--limit 1`
registry poll keeps the last value, exits non-zero on timeout and stops the release
evals.with_skill_result: 2026-10-11 claude-opus-5-5 with the skill (after the approval gate): pass on all assertions. It stopped for the user's OK before merging the release PR (naming PR and head SHA), before pushing v1.4.0 (naming the commit), and before merging the back-merge PR; manual npm publish only with approval. It watched the run found by `--commit` on the tag's commit with a bounded wait and `timeout 60m`. The npm poll kept `last`, exited 1 on timeout and stopped the release.

evals.prompt: Our monorepo (packages `@acme/core` and `@acme/cli`, version 0.4.2, cli depends on core with an exact pin) uses Changesets. `changesets/action` has opened PR #88 "Version packages" for 0.4.3. It shows no checks. Feature PR #91 with its own changeset merged into main 2 minutes ago. Afterwards we want to confirm the release. Give the exact plan with commands for getting from here to a verified release, including what you check in PR #88 and when you would merge it. Also: the patch contains a renamed export in core — is that OK under our setup? Keep it under 400 words.
expected: checks the Version PR's checks first; if no run was triggered (usual with GITHUB_TOKEN) does not wait for CI; if runs exist or wait for approval, handles them like normal CI
waits for #91's changeset to appear in the Version PR before merging
limits the allowed diff to changeset removals, CHANGELOGs, version fields and lockfile version lines; anything else goes to normal review
after merge confirms the tag and that latest (not next) shows the version
a failed registry query (e.g. 401) is confirmed another way before concluding failure
says the renamed export is a breaking change that must not ship as a patch, exact pin or not: under 0.x it takes a minor bump (0.5.0) via a `minor` changeset; a `major` changeset would bump to 1.0.0
evals.lived: Generalized session evidence (release sessions in a private monorepo, details withheld): four Version PRs opened by changesets/action showed zero checks; one Version PR lacked the changeset of a feature PR merged moments before; one `npm view` dist-tag query returned 401 (empty token in a subshell) although the release had succeeded. These lived failures serve as the control; no separate control run.
